video.title: Everything you need to know about AWS Cloud Practitioner ☁️ #aws

transcript.text: AWS Cloud Practitioner is a foundational
level certification in Amazon Web
Services platform. This certification is
for beginners who are very new to cloud
and have no idea about AWS or cloud in
general. Now, if you're someone who has
experience with the cloud and have
worked in the cloud for years, you can
choose to skip this Practitioner
certification and go for the Associate
level certifications. But, as
Practitioner is very easy, and if you
pass it, you get 50% off for your next
certification, I would recommend you
doing it. The jobs you can expect after
getting this certification mostly
include sales and marketing jobs in
cloud domain or non-technical jobs, as
this is a very foundational level
certification. But, you can also get
entry-level jobs in some companies.
